# Reclaim Deco

> Reclaim Deco (formerly Reclaimed NYC) sells new, open-box and pre-owned designer furniture below retail, with free delivery and removal of old furniture across the New York metro area. Warehouse at 101 Church St, Matawan, NJ 07747, open by appointment only.

- Brands carried: RH (Restoration Hardware), Herman Miller, Ekornes / Stressless, West Elm, Castlery (incl. Tan France x Castlery), Stickley, Ralph Lauren Home, Bernhardt, Ethan Allen, Knoll, Kartell, Geiger, Keilhauer, Coalesse, HAY, Universum.
- Categories: sofas and sectionals, lounge and accent chairs, dining tables and chairs, bar stools, coffee and side tables, storage and media, bedroom, rugs, mirrors, outdoor, office.
- How to order: message Reclaim Deco on Facebook Messenger (https://m.me/reclaimed.nyc) or email eric@reclaimed.nyc.
- Delivery: free across the New York metro area, including removal of the furniture being replaced. Nationwide freight shipping available by quote.

## Pages
- [Shop](https://reclaimdeco.com/): current inventory with prices and condition
- [About](https://reclaimdeco.com/about): who we are, brands, how to order, delivery and returns
